text:
Priya Patel: Heads-up — Helios Games QBR next Wed 10am PT. Need the token econ section, a 90-day spend forecast, and a proposed budget-alert plan. They've flagged embedding costs + a recent spike after the new matchmaking feature.
Jae Kim: I can run the forecast. Quick 30d snapshot: gen tokens ~1.8B, embeddings ~420M. With current growth ~25% MoM projected 90d tokens ~8.6B. Will break down by route and attach a burn curve.
Ethan Li: For embeddings: recommend batching + cached vectors for repeat queries, and a quantized embedding model for offline jobs — usually ~35-45% cost reduction. Also check rerank job cadence; sometimes those explode costs.
Mei O'Connor: Finance note: committed spend = $75k/mo, current run-rate $92k/mo. Renewal risk if trend continues. Suggest budget alerts at 75% and 90% of commit, and an overage scenarios slide for the QBR (commit bump vs throttle vs negotiated overage).
Priya Patel: Mei — can you draft the overage scenarios table? Include incremental pricing assumptions.
Noah Singh: Also schedule a 60-min enablement for Helios: best practices on batching, caching, and prompt design. Ethan to lead the session. Priya to own scheduling.
Ethan Li: I’ll prep a 10m demo showing batching config impact + quantization tradeoffs and a 1-page checklist for the customer.
Jae Kim: SQL to pull last 30d by route (useful for the deck):
```
SELECT route, SUM(tokens) as tokens, SUM(cost) as cost
FROM billing.events
WHERE customer_id='helios'
AND ts >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY cost DESC;
```
Link to ad-hoc burn dashboard: https://redwood.app/dashboards/helios-burn :eyes:
Priya Patel: Also flag: anomalous rerank batch on 2027-03-02 03:12 UTC — that added a big embedding spike. Can we add a rollback/mitigation recommendation?
Jae Kim: Confirmed. There was a scheduled rerank that ran x10 of expected volume. I'll add a rollback note and propose an alert rule: trigger when daily embedding cost delta > 50% and 1-hr rate > 3x baseline.
Mei O'Connor: For the QBR deck outline: slide 1 — exec summary; slide 2 — historical spend trend; slide 3 — forecast & scenarios; slide 4 — recommended ops & renewal options; slide 5 — enablement plan & feedback loop. I’ll draft slide 3 with the numbers.
Priya Patel: Action items recap: Jae — forecast, dashboard link, and alert rule; Ethan — enablement deck & demo; Mei — overage scenarios & renewal levers; Priya — schedule QBR + feedback template. Sync tomorrow 9am PT. :thumbsup:
Noah Singh: cc @billing-bot please schedule an invoice reminder 30 days before renewal.
billing-bot: Reminder scheduled: invoice_reminder for customer=helios days_before=30
Priya Patel: Thanks team — I'll send the invite and attach the deck draft once Mei/Jae have numbers.
